rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §1/§3/§9; flat LIGHT backgrounds; product cut out (ASUS PNGs have alpha); 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo end card; audio LOCKED. Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw no AMD/Radeon/ASUS/NVIDIA logos (text names only). '4,837 MHz' / 'world record' always with pill 'AMD says' or 'claimed'. Never show the record as a gaming speed.
palette_for_this_video: paper main; sky for the numbers; blush for THE CATCH; mint for SPEC
assets: assets_sources.md (A–E official ASUS press images, 2400 px)
new_objects: ln2Pot (copper LN2 pot sitting on a GPU die with pouring vapour curls + frost rim; reuse for any extreme-overclock / cooling story) — add to render/kit/OBJECTS.md. Reuse: priceTag, gauge, counter, questionStamp, gpuCard, speechBubble, chipDie, bars, ruler, thermometer, scoreTable, ramStick, pill.

scenes.note: frame 1 = poster A: card + '4.8 GHz' gauge peeking

scenes.anchor: just hit four point eight gigahertz.
scenes.object: gauge needle whips past 3.1 into red zone, counter '4.8 GHz'

scenes.anchor: Meet AMD's Radeon RX ninety-sixty XT.
scenes.object: gpuCard outline traces the shroud; label 'Radeon RX 9060 XT · 8/16 GB' (text only, no AMD/ASUS logos drawn)

scenes.anchor: AMD's graphics boss says it's a new world record.
scenes.object: speechBubble from a simple 'AMD exec' silhouette: 'WORLD RECORD!'; pill 'AMD says'

scenes.anchor: Get this. Four thousand eight hundred thirty-seven megahertz.
scenes.object: counter rolls 0→'4,837 MHz' huge; chipDie glows behind

scenes.anchor: That beats the old record by forty-eight.
And it's just a hundred sixty-three shy of five gigahertz!
scenes.object: ruler/progress bar 0→5,000 MHz, fill stops at 4,837, gap '163 MHz' flashes, finish flag at '5 GHz'

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. It ran on liquid nitrogen.
scenes.object: NEW object ln2Pot: copper pot on the die, vapour curls pour over the card; thermometer drops to the floor

scenes.anchor: The card you'd buy boosts to about three point one.
scenes.object: gauge: two needles — '3,130 MHz · official boost' (green) vs '4,837 · LN2' (red); pill 'AMD spec'

scenes.anchor: By our score? Sixty-one out of a hundred.
It's a spec. Grab it if you want sixteen gigs for three forty-nine.
scenes.object: k snaps upright (SPEC end-card motion); ramStick '16 GB' + priceTag '$349'; pill '✓ 16 GB under $400'

scenes.anchor: Would you pour liquid nitrogen on your GPU?
scenes.object: ln2Pot vapour drifts in over the card; questionStamp; ends on the frame-1 layout
